narrative.overview: The list is printed, not rendered: one near-white plate on uncoated stock, framed by registration crosshairs, divided by 1px hairlines, set in a single grotesque. It refuses the category default of a soft rounded card floating on grey with a blue accent. The page is an Operate surface: someone opens it, adds or ticks a task in seconds, and leaves. The world only lends type, palette, density and one signature move (the seal); layout and controls stay the ones everybody already knows.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet, one typeface, one accent.
Hairlines do all the dividing; there are no cards, panels or shadows.
The periwinkle seal is the only ornament and it carries real information (tasks left).
A dark variant prints the same sheet in reverse.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle belongs to the seal (and selection). No accent buttons, badges or highlights.

rules.name: The Red Is For Deleting Rule
rules.body: The alert colour appears only on the delete control when hovered.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Tabular figures only on counts (the footer count and the seal number), never on running text, where they put gaps around punctuation.

dos: Do keep one typeface and let size and the caps label style carry the hierarchy.
Do divide with 1px hairlines and leave the rest empty.
Do use one easing curve, `cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1)`, at 160ms for state changes.
Do test new text at 375px; long task names wrap and must never push the layout sideways.
donts: Don't add cards, panels, rounded corners or shadows.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use periwinkle for buttons.
Don't add ornament beyond the crosshairs and the seal (no dot patterns, stamps or textures).
Don't use pure black or flat neutral grey; take secondary text from Ink 2.
Don't add labels above the title.
